    GOLD RULES ENGINE Single-player or shared-device play · no account required

    Field manual

    Win by incapacitating all three opposing units. Select one of your units, choose an action, then select a cell or target. Each unit may move once and take one action each patrol turn, in either order.

    Rifle movement has a 1.5-cell radius; carbine movement has a 2.5-cell radius. Movement uses true straight-line distance. Routes cannot cross ruins, standing units, or blocked diagonal corners. Rubble gives light cover. Ruins block line of sight. Blue and orange highlights show legal moves and targets.

    Fire uses the original Gold C resolver: range, skill dice, cover, hit locations, wounds and ammunition. Units with a disabled arm cannot shoot; head, chest or abdomen depletion incapacitates them. First aid restores one wound to yourself or an adjacent standing ally on a successful roll. Reload consumes an action and a spare clip.

    This is a fictional skirmish adaptation, not a historical simulation. Board distances use the larger axis; one action and one move per turn, terrain, AI, fixed patrol loadouts and victory conditions are browser-game conventions. Shotguns, grenades, melee and campaign rules are not yet included. Enable Autopilot to watch AI control both patrols. Disable it at any time to take over the current patrol, keeping moves and actions already spent. Autopilot stops when the operation ends. Online means browser play; two-player mode shares one device.
